findings.title: Current source and A58 archive identity used POSIX execute bits as physical filesystem authority on Windows
findings.resolution: Canonical 0644/0755 mode identity now comes from an exact path allowlist. Windows filesystem execute bits are explicitly non-authoritative while bytes, paths, hashes and archive modes remain exact.

findings.title: A Windows extraction that preserved every byte but lost twelve POSIX execute bits failed the current descendant and A58 release-integrity gates
findings.resolution: A Linux/Windows canonical inventory parity contract now produces the same file count, bytes, path-set and aggregate digest from the same source bytes.

findings.title: Ignoring modes globally would weaken POSIX release integrity
findings.resolution: POSIX remains strict: every regular file must be exactly 0644 or an allowlisted executable exactly 0755; lost or unexpected execute bits fail closed.

findings.title: A58 independently recomputed physical modes from st_mode and therefore retained the Windows blocker
findings.resolution: A58 now consumes the same source-mode policy, verifies its revision and 23-path denominator, canonicalizes Windows mode identity and retains exact POSIX permission enforcement.

findings.title: The release-integrity fixture did not cover the new cross-platform mode authority
findings.resolution: A58 fixture and A102R39 adversarial tests cover Windows mode loss, POSIX mode loss, unexpected executability, duplicate/traversal policy paths, unknown platforms and canonical source inventory parity.

findings.title: Fresh exact Windows Node/npm builds, corrected production smokes and exact Chrome remain unexecuted on A102R39 bytes
findings.resolution: Run exact Windows Node 24.18.0/npm 11.16.0, genuine dependencies, Webpack, Turbopack, 55/55 unique smoke assertions, parity and exact Chrome on unchanged A102R39 bytes. Local cross-platform simulation is not Windows execution credit.

findings.title: Approved-change verifier depended on the parent embedded _velmere package manifest that is not carried into a child SOURCE_ONLY archive
findings.resolution: A hash-exact historical parent package manifest is retained at config/pass36/a102r39-parent-source-package-manifest.json, allowing complete parent-to-child diff verification after a clean current-source unpack.
